projectDescription: An ESP8266-based external PC hardware monitor that displays real-time CPU, GPU, and RAM stats on a tiny TFT screen, navigated via gesture sensor and configured through a captive-portal web interface.
keyFeatures: Real-time display of GPU temperature, GPU load, GPU fan speed, CPU temperature, CPU load, and RAM usage on a 0.96" ST7735 TFT screen
Gesture-based menu navigation using the APDS-9960 sensor (swipe up/down/left/right)
Data sourced from LibreHardwareMonitor's built-in web server over Wi-Fi
Captive-portal AP mode for initial Wi-Fi and LibreHardwareMonitor URL configuration
NTP-based clock display when not polling hardware data
Built with PlatformIO for the Wemos D1 Mini (ESP8266) target
Credentials and settings persisted in SPIFFS (LittleFS)
publicApiSurface: setup() — initialises SPIFFS, TFT, APDS-9960, Wi-Fi, and NTP
loop() — processes gesture ISR, updates display, or runs DNS server in AP mode
gestos() — reads APDS-9960 gesture and transitions the active screen (Menus enum)
getJSONdata(uint8_t Pantalla) — fetches LibreHardwareMonitor /data.json and extracts the value for the current screen
startupWifi() — reads credentials from SPIFFS and connects to the configured network
startAP() — brings up the Wi-Fi AP + DNS captive portal
initServer() — registers ESPAsyncWebServer routes (GET / and POST /)
startupST7735() — initialises the TFT and creates the two display sprites
startupAPDS() — initialises the APDS-9960 gesture engine
drawvalor(String valor) — renders the numeric/time value on the right sprite
CambioPantalla(uint8_t Pantalla) — renders the label text on the left sprite
Modowifi() — returns true when the device should start in AP mode (EEPROM flag)
defaultWifi() — clears the AP-mode flag and reboots to AP mode
Menus enum: Gputemp, Gpuload, Gpufan, Cputemp, Cpuload, RAM, Reloj
